dedupe_keys.name: definition of reference wind farms and simulation scenarios

description: Irigoyen, Uxue and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The report defines reference wind farms and simulation scenarios used to compare CL-Windcon flow-control technologies and prototypes. Its object is the published benchmark specification, with cases selected around the requirements of the modelling and demonstration work packages. This is a document-based simulation information resource, not a claim of observed farm operating data or a ready-to-run model archive. The abstract does not enumerate all geometries or forcing parameters, so those remain accessible through the linked report. Related model-comparison work is documented separately. Coverage is limited to the stated models, observations and application settings. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label cc-by-4.0. These terms describe the deposit; software and companion-data terms are distinguished where separately established. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected; linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
